'''Cameron Coiner''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[2001 Decipher World Championship]] on 16 November 2001 with [[Hidden Base / Systems Will Slip Through Your Fingers|Hidden Base with Insurrection]], according to Mike Merletto's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d3122">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-11-26-jewish-mother-va-beach-11-15-11-18d3122/ jewish-mother-va-beach-11-15-11-18], DeckTech (Mike "OQrygg" Merletto, 26 November 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-11-26-jewish-mother-va-beach-11-15-11-18d3122/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
